purpose: 5 game cover candidates, no runtime integration
common:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: finished landscape 16:9 visual-novel game cover, 2048x1152 preferred. Generate ONE complete cover, not a contact sheet or mockup.
Primary request: a beautifully art-directed cover for the Chinese romance visual novel 《毕节，雨停之前》 set in Bijie, Guizhou, China. Wenwen is the unmistakable MAIN PROTAGONIST, Maolang and Shijiang both visibly appear as secondary men, and ALL heroines appear ONLY as dark silhouettes.
Reference inputs in exact order: Image 1 Wenwen, image 2 Maolang, image 3 Shijiang: identity references, preserve their face shape, age, hairstyle, body build and recognizable outfits. Image 4 Huangqiuqiu: shape reference only, render as one SMALL unobtrusive round silhouette with her short cheek-supporting hand, never as a human. Image 5: Bijie architectural/environment reference only; do not reproduce any photographed person, watermark, logo or advertising text. The five human heroines are described below and MUST be silhouettes only.
Men: Wenwen 23, short dark buzz cut, soft round face and grounded friendly expression, charcoal work jacket open over gray T-shirt, repair tools clipped in jacket pocket; he is larger and more visually prominent than the other men. Maolang 24, narrow youthful face, tousled wavy short dark hair, black short-sleeve T-shirt with small multicolored flower-like motifs on LOWER hem, black wrist wrap, black pants, no hat no mask. Shijiang 32, stockier round/square face, thick black rectangular glasses, black-and-white handwritten-pattern bucket hat, white illustrated T-shirt and black sporty shorts, as in image 3. Keep the men recognizably distinct; no generic handsome face replacements.
Heroines: EXACTLY FIVE full human feminine silhouettes (all adults) plus ONE small orb silhouette. Five different silhouettes: 1 shoulder-length bob, casual jacket and trousers (Xiaoman); 2 long wavy hair, collared blouse and high-waist trousers (Zhouzhi); 3 loose ponytail with hanging camera outline (Mengyao); 4 low bun, tailored blazer and held folder outline (Yelan); 5 low ponytail, soft short-sleeve blouse and high-waist pants (Piao). Render them as clean, fully filled charcoal or ink-blue silhouettes, fine rim light ONLY on outer edges. NO visible eyes, nose, lips, face details, exposed skin color, internal clothes detail or sexy pinup poses. They must be clearly countable, separated, human-scaled and integrated into the setting as a story cast, not a horror crowd or cutout icon row.
Style: refined contemporary semi-realistic illustrated game key art, painterly environmental realism matching the supplied rendered character assets, emotionally restrained, tactile architecture, filmic lighting. Focus on ordinary adult relationships and returning to a lived-in city. No fantasy, combat or crime-thriller cues.
Typography: the ONLY prominent text is the exact Chinese title, in refined large ivory Song/Ming serif lettering, two lines: first line "毕节，" second line "雨停之前". The full title MUST read "毕节，雨停之前", exactly. Small text "贵州 · 毕节" allowed. No English subtitles, invented slogans, credits, option letters, menu UI or watermarks.
Composition: left upper/central 32% is calm low-detail space for the title; title fully legible and does not overlap faces. All faces within safe 8% margins. Main male foreground, other two men subordinate, all five heroines and orb are secondary. A clear hierarchy; don't make every figure the same scale or arrange eight people in a flat lineup. Portrait references are NOT background plates; render a fully integrated new scene.

options.name: 老街雨夜
options.direction: Art direction A — CINEMATIC RAINY MARKET. Adapt the tight bustling Bijie market lane in image 5 into a blue-hour light-rain scene: tiled apartment façades with metal window cages, dense overhead utility wires, red awnings, warm small shop lights, wet road reflecting subdued reds and amber. Architecture specifically from the supplied market reference, not a Japanese street or cyberpunk city. Wenwen is a luminous waist-up protagonist in the right-center foreground, face and jacket unmistakable; Maolang at far right behind him, Shijiang at center midground behind him, both faces visible and roughly 55-65% his scale. On the left-to-middle receding market walkway, place the five separated adult heroine silhouettes against warm shop light, their distinct hair/camera/folder outlines readable; small orb silhouette near one shop threshold. Rich ink blue, restrained amber and muted red. The title occupies dark upper-left over softly resolved buildings. High emotional cinematic impact; realistic rain with fine streaks, no umbrella obscuring any face.

options.name: 河桥暮色
options.direction: Art direction B — RIVER AND BRIDGE AT DUSK. Use the actual visual geometry of image 5: Bijie urban river with stone riverbank balustrades, a flat pedestrian bridge, a layered mix of gray tiled older mid-rise homes and taller residences. Soft mauve-gray dusk sky, cool river, amber window lights after light rain. Sweeping horizontal composition with river reflections as negative space at left. Wenwen is on the right foreground beside the stone balustrade, large chest-up three-quarter view, thoughtful but warm. Maolang and Shijiang stand farther back on either side of the right river path, smaller but clearly recognizable. Place exactly five heroine silhouettes at varied natural spacings along the lit bridge in the central background, with clear different outlines; the small orb silhouette rests discretely near the bridge rail. The silhouettes are dark with dusk rim light, all five easily countable. The title is large in the left upper sky, not over figures. An expansive romantic ensemble cover with quiet city depth, not a fantasy skyline. Preserve the river and bridge as the distinctive cover motif.

options.name: 树荫旧院
options.direction: Art direction C — QUIET GREEN COURTYARD. Derive the scene from image 5's ordinary Bijie residential courtyard: abundant deep-green mature tree canopy, weathered tiled apartment balconies with steel window cages, old wooden park bench, stone path. The rain has just weakened to a fine drizzle; soft late-afternoon light filters through wet leaves with restrained amber highlights. Wenwen is seated on the right half of the bench leaning very slightly forward, large clear three-quarter figure, face recognizable, work jacket and gray T-shirt intact, natural hands. Maolang and Shijiang are standing near the far end of the courtyard path on the right, smaller secondary figures with visible faces. Exactly five heroine silhouettes in the background and middle ground along the pale misty footpath behind the bench, spatially separated, all five legible in outline, plus a discreet round orb silhouette near the far bench leg. Reserve dark leafy left upper area for the ivory Song-serif title. This version is the most warm, quiet and intimate option: natural greens, worn concrete, memories of home. Not a school campus, no school uniforms, no decorative fantasy elements.

options.name: 木楼听雨
options.direction: Art direction D — RAIN ON THE OLD TIMBER BUILDING. Base the environment closely on image 5's distinctive multistory weathered Chinese timber building: rounded projecting wooden lattice windows, several layers of gray clay tile eaves, aged dark timber, some lush small roofline plants. This is an urban Bijie old wooden building, not a temple or palace. Use a striking slightly low-angle composition at overcast blue hour, fine rainfall dripping from curved eaves, warm dim window lights. Wenwen is dominant at right-center in a close waist-up composition under the eaves, crisp recognizable face and work jacket; Maolang and Shijiang occupy smaller secondary positions at lower right and central middle ground, both recognizable. Five heroine silhouettes are distributed naturally under the ground-level sheltered wooden arcade against warm light, separated and countable, not trapped in windows or ghost figures, plus a discreet round orb silhouette by a timber post. Left third is shadowed timber/soft rain with the large ivory serif title. Strong architectural depth and literary period-film-poster restraint while all costumes remain contemporary. Weathered ochre wood, slate blue, warm ivory.

options.name: 坡巷归途
options.direction: Art direction E — RETURN UP THE SLOPING LANE. Use image 5's authentically ordinary steep narrow Bijie street: gray-blue tiled residential walls, utility poles and tangled overhead cables, window cages, faded signs and an uphill vanishing point. Reimagine at the last pale light of a rainy day, a warm break in the clouds above the uphill lane, wet asphalt, restrained soft teal-gray and golden light. Compose a dynamic diagonal leading from lower right up to center. Wenwen is a prominent knee-up protagonist walking gently toward the viewer at right-center, clearly recognizable buzz cut, face and work jacket. Maolang and Shijiang appear smaller at different distances behind him on the right side of the incline, clear identities, not wearing different costumes. Exactly five heroines are separate dark silhouettes standing at staggered shop thresholds on both sides farther up the lane, their bob/waves/ponytails/bun/camera/folder outlined with light, no faces or skin. The small round orb silhouette is near a threshold on the left. The ivory serif Chinese title sits calmly in the open left third over a dark softly rendered wall. Most forward-moving and hopeful direction, a city he is returning to, not an action movie. No extra recognizable passersby or vehicles blocking the cast.
